title: AASHOOR KI SEHAR HAI DEYAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
body:
AASHOOR KI SEHAR HAI DEYAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
1. AASHOOR KI SEHAR HAI DEYAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
HAR CHASHM AAJ TARR HAI DETAY HAI AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
2. AAWAAZ GOONJTI HAI MAIDAN E KARBALA MAY
HAR ZARRA PUR ASAR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
3. RAFTAAR NABI KI HAI GUFTAAR NABI KI HAI
HUM SHAKLE PAYAMBAR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
4. HASRAT SE DEKHTAY HAI SHABBIR SOWAY AKBAR
ANJAAM PAR NAZAR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
5. SAB LASHKAR E AADA BHI KEHTE HAIN YE HASRAT SE
AAWAZ E PAYAMBER HAIN DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
6. GUZRI SHAB E AASHOORA SAB HAQQ KI IBADAT MAY
YE RAATA YE AAQIR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
7. SUNKAR SADAY E AKBAR AHLE HARAM HAI GIRYAAN
DIL SABKE NOUHA GAR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
8. LABBAIK KEHKAY TU BHI CHAL SAIF KARBALA KO
UTH TUJHKO KUCH KHABAR HAI DETAY HAIN AZAAN AKBAR
AZZ: SAIF
